item.title: Ask HN: What is one simple thing LLMs are insanely bad at?
item.summary: I am looking for ideas on what to train a specialized model for! What is one simple thing you repeatedly ask ChatGPT, Claude, or another model to do that it still somehow messes up? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49443820 Points: 20 # Comments: 30
